prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 12 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1454; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate onset of low back pain radiating into the right buttock, with muscle spasm and reduced lumbar range of motion. Neurological examination revealed intact sensation and strength in both lower extremities, and straight leg raise testing was negative bilaterally. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red flag findings. Diagnosis was acute lumbar strain with associated paraspinal muscle spasm.

Treatment consisted of twelve outpatient visits over the course of the episode of care, including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise focused on core stabilization and flexibility, and home exercise program instruction. Anti-inflammatory medication and short-term muscle relaxant were prescribed early in care and tapered as symptoms improved. Pain scores decreased steadily, and functional tolerance for sitting, lifting, and driving improved in parallel. At the most recent visit the patient reported minimal residual discomfort with full lumbar range of motion. Discharge to independent home exercise is recommended, with return precautions provided should symptoms recur or new neurological symptoms develop.
